what_it_is.quote: wmic.exe used to create a process, often for lateral movement.

esql.query: from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\wmic.exe") and process.command_line like "*process*" and process.command_line like "*call*" and process.command_line like "*create*"

kql.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FolderPath endswith "\\wmic.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine contains "process" and ProcessCommandLine contains "call" and ProcessCommandLine contains "create")

title: WMIC remote process creation
triage_tips: Check CommandLine for /node: - if present, the target is another host.
Known false positive: old management scripts. Check for these first.
Severity is medium; maps to attack.execution, t1047.
what_it_is: Sigma rule that fires when wmic.exe runs with process, call and create in its command line, often used for lateral movement.
why_it_flags: A process_creation event has Image ending in \wmic.exe and a CommandLine containing all of: process, call, create.
